title: Config change safety mediator with batch-sim and state harmonization
creator: Amira Patel
description: Problem: Recent config rollouts that change batching, KV cache size, and prefix caching policies have caused intermittent latency regressions and cost spikes. Root causes are often complex interactions between autoscaler timing, prefix cache warmup, and partially-applied policy shards across nodes. We need an automated system that mediates config applies by running a fast batch simulation, applying guardrails that can block or stage changes, and performing a safe state harmonization (reconcile) with deterministic rollback paths.
technical_approach: 1) Preflight: run a fast, sampling-based batch/caching simulator against recent production traces (sequences + prefix distribution) to estimate latency p50/p99 and token-cost delta. 2) Safety gates: compute a compact risk score combining simulated latency delta, cost delta, and prefix-warmup risk; if above threshold, mark change as blocked or staged canary. 3) Staged apply: if allowed, float a cohort (logical prefix cohorts) with delayed KV activation and 'prefix quarantine' to avoid cache thrash. 4) Live monitors: short-window SLI checks (latency, error-rate, cost-per-token) and deterministic rollback triggers. 5) Reconciliation: if partial apply detected (mix of old/new state across nodes), run the state harmonizer to either resume rollforward or orchestrate a clean rollback with captured snapshots of KV prefixes and routing table. 6) Post-mortem: automated tagging of telemetry and one-click reproducer trace for SEV analysis.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight simulator runs within 90s for a 1h sampled trace and produces latency & cost estimates
Risk score computed and matched to policy table to decide Block/Stage/Apply
Staged cohort apply applies config to <=5% traffic with prefix quarantine enabled
Automatic rollback triggers when short-window p99 increases >25% or cost delta >30% over baseline
State harmonizer can detect a mixed-state cluster and either roll forward cleanly or restore previous state within 3 minutes
End-to-end integration tests (simulator -> staged apply -> monitor -> rollback) pass in CI with deterministic outcomes
progress_updates: 2025-01-20: Prototype of trace sampler and micro-simulator completed (Jae). Early results show simulated p99 correlates with prod within ±12% for our test models.
2025-01-28: Risk scoring rubric drafted with PM and SRE: weighted factors = [latency:0.5, cost:0.3, prefix-warmup:0.2]. Thresholds for Block/Stage/Apply defined.
2025-02-02: Staged apply design reviewed with runtime infra; decided on cohort selection by prefix hash ranges and a 2-phase KV activation (shadow-write then promote).
2025-02-04: Integration test harness scaffolded; can simulate mixed-state cluster by toggling agent versions and applying partial config changes. Observed race condition in reconcile path documented.
open_risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Simulator mismatch for long-tail sequences. Mitigation: increase sampling of long sequences and add 'long-tail multiplier' in risk score.
Risk: Quarantine increases latency for quarantined prefixes. Mitigation: limit quarantine window and enforce fallback to older cache for high-QPS prefixes.
Risk: Rollback path could conflict with ongoing autoscaler changes. Mitigation: introduce a short 'control-plane lock' during staged apply to serialize scaling/config ops at cohort boundaries.
test_plan: Unit tests for simulator components with synthetic traces
CI integration test that runs full staging flow against a 3-node local cluster
Chaos test: kill a node mid-staged-apply to exercise reconcile and rollback
Load test: ensure staged cohort at 5% does not exceed latency SLOs for remaining 95%
